falsifiable_hypothesis: A lineage permitted to modify the mechanism that turns evidence into candidate transformations will, after meeting a limitation that mechanism cannot express, construct and adopt a validated modification of it; and on a later, independently materialized problem the modified mechanism will generate a corrective transformation lying outside the constructive image of the original mechanism, producing a correct outcome the same lineage with a frozen mechanism does not reach under any budget.

grammar.starting_body: M047 renderers, with the alias table and route table drawn from the salt
grammar.limitation: a pair of public cases: one naming a token absent from the alias table, one naming an operation present in the alias table and absent from the route table
grammar.why: so that repairing the alias cannot reveal a new fault, which is the cascade the predecessor had to remove from a hand-written bank
grammar.hidden_cases: same operations, different operands, never shown to the mechanism

fixed_meta.removes: the ability to modify the mechanism

meta_acquisition_ablated.removes: the adopted modification before the holdout

conditions.P1: evolvable_meta adopts exactly one validated mechanism modification, with rejected alternatives recorded
conditions.P2: evolvable_meta solves the holdout on the evaluator's hidden cases
conditions.P3: fixed_meta does not solve the holdout, and the enumerated constructive image of the starting mechanism contains no passing candidate
conditions.P4: meta_acquisition_ablated does not solve the holdout
conditions.P5: task_only_mutable does not solve the holdout
conditions.P6: the adopted holdout patch is outside the starting mechanism's constructive image
conditions.P7: the causal chain is serialized and audited end to end
conditions.P8: a forced fault during meta-adoption is detected and restored byte-identically against an independently recorded digest
conditions.P9: the chronology is proved from recorded digests and git order
conditions.P10: the starting mechanism is differentially equivalent to M047's frozen pair

verdict_rule: positive if and only if every one of P1 through P10 is true; a single false makes the result negative

failure_classification.negative: any of P1 through P10 false; a control success or an empty meta-search is informative and preserved
failure_classification.inconclusive: the sandbox cannot run; not runnable is not negative
failure_classification.positive: all ten true on the first materialized bank, with no rerun

prohibited_adaptation: reuse the predecessor's bank, holdout or result as evidence
amend this protocol after the bank is materialized
rerun a materialized bank for any reason
materialize the holdout before the adopted mechanism is committed
leave any condition documentary rather than computed
compare a restored mechanism against its own checkpoint record
shape the grammar so that a particular meta-primitive must win
let a foundation model generate, select or rank the meta-transformation
claim any generality gate, open-ended evolution or arbitrary self-improvement
